title: I Capture the Castle by Dodie Smith (1948)
text: “I write this sitting in the kitchen sink.” Cassandra Mortmain introduces herself to readers with an unexpected confession that establishes three things—she is small enough to still fit in a sink, she is unconventional and she is fearless. This coming-of-age tale about a teenage wannabe writer navigating an increasingly tumultuous home life maintains its fresh, unique point of view throughout.
